quick.title: Find your flat, see its sun
quick.placeholder: Address, or paste the listing text
quick.intro: Paste an address, or all the text of a listing. When it is found, tap your building on the map and see the sun on every side.
quick.consent.title: Connect to OpenStreetMap?
quick.consent.body: The map, the address search and the building outlines connect to the public servers of OpenStreetMap.
quick.consent.sends: What is sent: the address you typed, the part of the map you look at, and the position of the building (to about 1 metre). Your floor and the results are not sent.
quick.consent.hosts: Servers: nominatim.openstreetmap.org, tile.openstreetmap.org, overpass-api.de (and two others when it is busy).
quick.declined: Without a connection there is no map to tap. The full editor works offline, and you can type the coordinates there.
quick.foundExact: Found it. Tap your building on the map.
quick.foundStreet: Found the street but not the house number. Tap your building on the map.
quick.none: No address matched. Try fewer words, or move the map to where you live.
quick.tapBuilding: Tap your building on the map.
quick.noOutlines: No building outlines here. Tap the spot of your home on the map, then choose "Use this point".
quick.loadFailed: The buildings around could not be loaded, so the result does not count anything that blocks the sun.
quick.loadHere: Load the buildings around the middle of the map
quick.usePoint: No outline here: use this point
quick.pointNote: This building has no outline, so it is taken as a square 10 metres across with its walls facing north, east, south and west. The real ones may differ.
quick.map.aria: Map of the buildings. Tap your building, or an arrow to say a window faces that way. Drag to move, pinch to zoom.
quick.floor.over: The map data says this building has {n} floors. Check your floor.
quick.card.summerNone: Summer afternoons: almost no direct sun
quick.card.chart: Hours of sun on the 15th of each month, January to December
quick.sorted: Most afternoon sun first. Tap the side your windows face.
quick.summary.pick: You have not said which way your windows face. Every side is worked out below, so tap yours.
quick.summary.head: Your windows face: {sides}
quick.help: Not sure which way the windows face? Tap that side on the map, or look at which street the listing photos show outside the window.
quick.working: Working out the sun on each side.
quick.nosides: No wall of this building is long enough for a window.
quick.party: Walls shared with a neighbour are left out.
quick.how.title: How it is worked out
quick.how.body: Each side gets a window of 1.8 by 1.5 metres, sill 0.9 metres up, on the floor you picked at 3 metres a floor. The buildings around come from OpenStreetMap, and a height it does not have is guessed from the buildings next to it ({est} of {total} here). Afternoon is 14:00 to sunset, counted from 1 June to 30 September, and winter is December. A side has direct sun when more than a quarter of its window is lit.
quick.adv.title: More
quick.adv.room: See where the sun lands in the room
quick.adv.roomNote: Opens the room editor with this place, floor and the buildings around already in.
quick.adv.roomNeed: First tap the side your windows face.
quick.adv.full: The compare list is full (4 flats). Remove one first.
quick.compare.title: Compare
quick.compare.empty: Nothing to compare yet. After you look at a flat, press "Add to compare".
quick.compare.saveFailed: This browser would not keep the list.
quick.nearest: Use the building nearest the address
quick.share.aria: Share this answer as a link
quick.share.title: Sunspill sun check
quick.share.text: The sun on every side of {place}, {floor}. Open the link to see it.
quick.share.manual.title: Copy this link
quick.share.manual.body: Your browser would not copy it for you. Select the line below and copy it yourself.
quick.link.gone: The building in that link is not on the map any more. Tap the one you want.
quick.deals.title: Nearby past deals
quick.deals.none: No deals data for this area yet. It covers Taipei, New Taipei, Taichung and Taoyuan.
quick.deals.missing: This copy of the page comes without the deals data.
quick.deals.failed: The deals data did not load.
quick.deals.salesCount: {n} sales within 300 m in the last 12 months
quick.deals.salesNone: No sales within 300 m in the last 12 months.
quick.deals.rentsMiddle: median {rent} NTD a month, {perPing} NTD per ping
quick.deals.rentsNone: No rentals within 300 m in the last 12 months.
quick.deals.sameMore: {n} more of the same building are not shown.
quick.deals.units: 1 萬 is 10,000 NTD. 1 ping (坪) is about 3.3 square metres.
quick.deals.source: Source: Ministry of the Interior real price registration service (under the Open Government Data License, version 1)
quick.deals.sourcePoints: Positions: house number points of the Taipei, New Taipei, Taichung and Taoyuan city governments (same licence)
